- Added a reusable `make_invoice` helper to `tests/conftest.py`.

Invoice pagination, unscoped scans, per-document embeddings, per-vector transactions, webhook retries.

### Next steps
Review and minimally correct `apply_credit` ordering; run the focused invoice test, billing tests, and full suite; then commit appropriately.
